summary: Add nex-controller Debian packaging and software-update APIs for Controller and Core local, with minimal Updates UI.

guide.reason: New operator Updates workflow on Controller and host-local UI.

api.reason: Runtime API impact: new contract. Four update routes and UpdateStatus/UpdateApplyResult schemas; both OpenAPI contracts regenerated.

state.reason: Software-update behaviour only: the repository location and signing key live in host-local package configuration (/etc/nex/updates.conf, APT sources) owned by the package, not a pool setting, and the Controller stores nothing.

verification.method: go test ./internal/nexupdate ./internal/version ./internal/controller ./internal/localcore (update-focused), python3 scripts/generate_api.py; GUI browser walkthrough against a live update repo outstanding.
